scope: Inventory and battle-loot weapon details use the shared existing detail view and equipment callbacks; no weapon, skill, enemy or relic gameplay configuration changed.

implementation.surface: Shared forest window and walnut title artwork, opaque emerald backing, brass skill cards and gold equipment controls.
sourceOfTruth: Weapon_SO: localized name/description, rarity, type, speedButtonCount, icon, inventory quantity and skillPool.
EnemySkill_SO: localized skill name/description, energyCost, GetDicePowerRange and GetDiceSkillCategory per die.

The existing BattleSkillInfoOverlay rule formatter: triggers, conditions, targets, status stacks, damage and extra rules; configuration values without battle modifiers or an invented current stack count.
implementation.layout: Two aligned skill columns in wide viewports; a single scrolling column in narrower layouts; compact profile across the top when needed; safe-area-aware positioning; persistent footer actions.
implementation.overflow: Every die and its complete actual rules are always in the skill reading area. Extra skill narrative expands/collapses on card tap. Weapon narrative has its own independent scroll area.
implementation.functionality: Existing equipment/disabled-state/inventory callbacks retained. Same-weapon equipment refresh retains reading position and description expansion. Switching to other item categories restores the original presentation.
implementation.motion: Unscaled 0.24-second open and 0.16-second close, staggered card reveal, 0.16-second description disclosure, soft hover rims and existing mouse/touch button feedback. Works while the game is paused.

knownUnrelatedFailure.reason: Existing shipped encyclopedia index order differs from the current asset scan at index 74. This test only compares catalog/identity data and does not invoke the inventory/detail UI.
knownUnrelatedFailure.handling: Recorded without changing unrelated catalog/content files.

coverage: All 26 actual Weapon_SO assets and each configured distinct skill, energy cost, die count, die category and range.
Two-die per-segment conditions and all-attacks-hit shield; required status thresholds and consume/keep policy.
Long mixed attack/defense dice rules, 90 configured effects, long names/narrative, null/duplicate pools, no-skill fallback and zero dice.
Normal inventory slot raycast, card disclosure, physical equipment-button raycast and original equipment action.
Paused wheel/drag scrolling, closing while paused, modal input lifecycle, reading offset preservation and equipment persistence in the authored rest scene.
2340x1080, 1920x1080, 1600x1200, 2400x1080 with asymmetric safe insets, and 1080x1920 with safe insets.
validation.previewPolicy: Previews and intermediate logs stay local; formal code, metadata, tests and this validation record are committed.
